items.title: Berkshire Hathaway’s Utility Is Asking for a Historic Rate Hike in California
items.summary: A Berkshire-owned utility wants far more from 46,000 customers in rural California, while its credit rating sits one notch above junk and its parent quietly pulls back. Is this a billion-dollar blip or an early warning for Buffett's empire?

items.title: Dow Jones Futures: Market Needs Repair But Apple, Amazon, Microsoft Strong; Berkshire Doubles Stock Buyback
items.summary: The stock market needs repair while Sandisk and Micron seem broken. Apple, Amazon and Microsoft are holding up. Berkshire earnings fell.

items.title: Warren Buffett's Berkshire Compounded at More Than 19% a Year Over Six Decades, Nearly Double the S&P 500's 10% Return. Can Investors Still Apply That Playbook Today?
items.summary: If you'd invested $5,000 in Berkshire stock 60 years ago, you would be sitting on a massive fortune today.

items.title: Berkshire Hathaway’s Quarterly Profit Falls After Investment Gains Shrink
items.summary: The conglomerate posted a 28% decline in quarterly net income after investment gains slumped and its insurance operations reported lower profits.

items.title: Berkshire Hathaway buys back $9.6 billion of its own stock but its profits declined
items.summary: (AP) — Berkshire Hathaway repurchased $9.6 billion worth of its own shares in the third quarter, but Geico's numbers got worse as it invested more in ads and its overall profit fell more than 28% as the value of its investments changed.

items.title: Berkshire’s Operating Earnings Fell 6%. Buybacks Hit $9.6B.
items.summary: Operating earnings were depressed by weaker underwriting and investment income at the company’s large insurance units.

items.title: Berkshire Hathaway steps up buybacks as operating profit falls
items.summary: Investing.com - Berkshire Hathaway reported a 5.8% drop in third-quarter operating earnings on Saturday, weighed down by weaker insurance results even as its cash pile climbed to a record $377.4 billion and the conglomerate stepped up share repurchases.

items.title: Consumers Are Now Worried About an AI Bubble, Michigan Survey Says
items.summary: Sentiment improved for almost everyone except the households holding the most stock, and a survey that closed days before a brutal selloff may already be out of date. What do those wealthy investors see that others don't?
